synopsis: IEC TS 61496-5:2023 addresses radar protective devices and gives them an established certification basis [f438, f672, f12393]. The glossary places it within the IEC 61496 series for electro-sensitive protective equipment, alongside general requirements, light curtains and laser scanners, and describes radar devices that stop a factory machine when someone enters a zone [f12389, f15277]. Both Chapter 1 and the glossary explicitly state that the radar specification does not consider aspects of a moving radar protective device application [f673, f1040, f12393, f15278]. Thus, the established certification basis should not be read as resolving the moving-application gap relevant to this validation work [f672, f673, f12393].
